text: Call me. Seriously, put down this booklet and call my personal cell: (408)768-5247. Hesitant? Read this first.

Last year, three Berryessa schools closed, including my childhood elementary school, and I voted yes on a tax increase to keep our hospitals open. Meanwhile, billions of our tax dollars were diverted overseas to drop bombs on schools, hospitals, and universities. We heard we couldn't afford to reduce homelessness, while billions of our tax dollars rendered two million people homeless. We heard we couldn't afford universal healthcare, while billions of our tax dollars enriched foreign countries that have enjoyed universal healthcare for decades.
What's my background? Independence High School valedictorian. UC Berkeley High Honors. Harvard Law School. Obama White House. But my foundation was Berryessa K-8. My roots run deep.

More schools may close. I can't guarantee they won't. No one can. The deck is stacked against us at the macro, and the budget numbers must work at the micro. But here's what I can promise: if elected, I will be transparent and accessible, doing everything in my power to ensure today's Berryessa students have access to the same high-quality education I once did at a school that no longer exists. Questions? Call me: (408)768-5247.

text: President of the Berryessa Union School District Board/Nonprofit Director
My name is Jaria (pronounced like 'Mariah' but with a 'J') Jaug and I am President of the Berryessa School Board running for re-election.

As a proud product of our Berryessa schools and having lived in Berryessa my entire life, I am honored to have served Berryessa for the last four years. Under my leadership, we have advanced academic achievement for all students, improved student safety, and paved pathways for the future.

I have kept my promise of ensuring that all students are provided the resources they need to succeed. Students have options for after-school programs, online tutoring, and summer math programs. To improve student safety, we invested in and accelerated construction for safer routes to school and secure classrooms. We have also found ways to bring new funding and programs, like renting out unused sites to bring affordable childcare. With my innovative and collaborative track record, I would be honored to earn your vote to continue to make our schools the best that they can be.

Please reach me at
(408) 463-6857 or votejariajaug@gmail.com

text: For the past year, it has been my privilege to serve on the Berryessa Union School District Board of Trustees. During a year of significant transition, I listened to families, responded to community concerns, and helped guide thoughtful decisions for our students and staff. I am proud of the progress we've made, including advancing campus improvements, transforming the Toyon and Laneview campuses to serve our community, and beginning the development of a long-term strategic plan.

This district has shaped my life as a student, parent, and now Trustee. My years as a PTA leader and School Site Council member reinforced my belief that schools thrive when families, educators and the community work together.

I bring more than 20 years of leadership and organizational strategy experience. Today, I serve on the Board's strategic planning subcommittee, helping lead a community-wide effort to shape our district's vision for the next seven to ten years.
As your Trustee, I will continue working collaboratively, making thoughtful, fiscally responsible decisions, and keeping students at the center of every decision.
It would be an honor to earn your vote and continue serving our Berryessa community.
